about: Vallarith's travel map (dungeon/travel.py, docs/story.md "Journeys"): places joined by roads, each road with its hours on foot, terrain and danger, each region's road encounters, and each region's danger and night-camp encounters for resting out in the open (dungeon/rest.py), and the world and region its Life Cards draw from (dungeon/happenings.py). Positions are from the world map (dungeon/world/packages/vallarith/settlements.json). A node is a whole town (its city and arrival place) or a place on the Road (dungeon/world/data/cities/vallarith-road.json). A hex crawl (dungeon/hexes.py): its hexes are world/data/hexes/vallarith.json, and land off the edge of that map is generated in play, in the wilds.

routes.terrain: the strait road through the war country
the old forest past the border stones

kingdom-of-cyrel.text: A carter going the other way, with news from Cyrel, a sore back and a jug he is willing to share.
A royal patrol stops the character, asks their business, and looks hard at what they carry.
Deserters from the Asanian front, hanged at a crossroads with signs round their necks.

kingdom-of-cyrel.action: slip past the toll-takers on the road without paying twice
kingdom-of-cyrel.threat: Road wardens who are not wardens stop the character for a crown's toll and a long look into the purse.

kingdom-of-cyrel.action: spot the bandits' ambush before it springs

threat.text: Bandits come out of the ditch on both sides of the road, cudgels up.

kingdoms-of-man.text: A licensed mage's coach thunders past, its brooch-wearing guards watching the ditches.
A village with half its lamps dark: the crystal allocation was cut and nobody says by whom.

kingdoms-of-man.action: keep clear of the press gang working the road for the Asanian army

threat.text: An Asanian press gang closes in with a rope and a recruiting sergeant's smile.

badlands.text: Old bones and older weapons where the horde came through, picked clean and bleached.

badlands.action: find water before the sun finishes its work
badlands.threat: The water runs out a day early. Thirst sets in, and with it the shakes.

badlands.action: see the raiders before they see the character

threat.text: Unguruk raiders ride down off the ridge, whooping, blades out.

badlands.action: stay off the old ground where the wards have failed

threat.text: Something long dead and badly buried pulls itself out of the shale.

brynwyr.text: Trees older than the kingdom, and a silence so deep the character's own breathing sounds rude.
A young elf, curious and armed, watches from the branches and asks a single question.

brynwyr.action: keep to the warden path and out of the wardens' sight

threat.text: Wardens close in among the trees, unseen, bows drawn.

dwarven-empire.text: A dwarven ore train grinds past on iron-shod wheels, its guards counting the character with their eyes.
Cairns on the ridge, each with a name cut into the top stone and a clan mark under it.

dwarven-empire.action: find the pass marker before the weather closes in
dwarven-empire.threat: Cloud comes down over the pass and the cold with it. Fingers stop working; the way down takes half the night.

dwarven-empire.action: spot the Rulan Gaan lookouts first

threat.text: Rulan Gaan cultists rise out of the scree with hooked spears and painted faces.

torogh-highlands.text: The loch below, flat and black, and a boat on it that does not seem to move.
A shepherd and her dogs, who point the way and want nothing for it but news.

torogh-highlands.action: keep footing on the wet shale
torogh-highlands.threat: A slide of wet shale takes the character down twenty feet of slope. Bruised all along one side.

torogh-highlands.action: hear the snow cat before it springs

threat.text: A snow cat drops off a ledge onto the path, ears flat.

eastern-forests.text: Trees so close the light goes green, and a lake through them that nobody has put on a map.
A charcoal burner's clearing, long abandoned, the kiln cold and full of nesting birds.

eastern-forests.action: keep the sun on the right side
eastern-forests.threat: The trees all look the same by noon. Half a day lost walking in a wide circle.

eastern-forests.action: smell the bear before walking into its ground

threat.text: A bear comes up out of the ferns, standing, close enough to smell.

eastern-forests.action: notice the snares before stepping in one

threat.text: A snare jerks tight and three hunters in green step out of the trees to see what they caught.

wilds.text: Country nobody in Kingswood has a name for: open, quiet, and older than the maps.
A standing stone with words cut in a script the character has never seen.

wilds.action: find water before the skins run dry
wilds.threat: No stream, no spring, no rain. The skins run dry and thirst sets in.

wilds.action: see the pack before it sees the character

threat.text: Grey wolves, a whole pack of them, fanning out through the grass.

wilds.action: stay clear of the hollow where the ground is wrong

threat.text: Something that was a man once crawls out of the hollow on too many joints.

kingdom-of-cyrel.text: A farm dog barks half the night at something past the firelight, and nothing comes of it.
A shepherd asks to share the fire and talks until he falls asleep in the middle of a sentence.

kingdom-of-cyrel.action: find a dry hollow before the rain comes in
kingdom-of-cyrel.threat: Rain comes through in the small hours and soaks everything. Nobody sleeps.

kingdom-of-cyrel.action: wake before the men from the road reach the fire

threat.text: Two men from the road creep up on the camp in the dark, knives out.

kingdoms-of-man.text: A mage's lamp drifts over the fields at midnight, looking for something, and moves on.

kingdoms-of-man.action: keep the fire hidden from the press gang's night patrol

threat.text: An Asanian press gang closes in with a rope and a recruiting sergeant's smile.

badlands.text: Drums, far off, and then nothing until dawn.

badlands.action: keep the cold off without a fire that shows for miles
badlands.threat: The night cold gets into the bones. Nobody sleeps, and morning finds the character stiff and shaking.

badlands.action: hear the raiders before they reach the camp

threat.text: Unguruk raiders ride down off the ridge, whooping, blades out.

badlands.action: keep away from the old ground where the dead walk

threat.text: Something long dead and badly buried pulls itself out of the shale.

brynwyr.text: Lights move between the trees all night, silent, never coming closer.

brynwyr.action: find ground the forest does not mind being slept on
brynwyr.threat: Roots, stones and whispering. The forest does not let the character sleep.

brynwyr.action: stay out of the wardens' sight

threat.text: Wardens close in among the trees, unseen, bows drawn.

dwarven-empire.text: Wind all night, and the stars very close.

dwarven-empire.action: build a wall of stones against the wind
dwarven-empire.threat: The cold gets in under everything. Morning finds the character grey and shaking.

dwarven-empire.action: wake before the cultists reach the fire

threat.text: Rulan Gaan cultists come out of the dark with nets and hooked spears.

torogh-highlands.text: Something big moves on the loch in the night, and the water slaps the stones for an hour after.

torogh-highlands.action: find a dry spot out of the wind
torogh-highlands.threat: Rain off the loch soaks everything. Nobody sleeps.

torogh-highlands.action: hear the snow cat on the rocks above

threat.text: A snow cat comes down to the firelight, hungry enough not to care about it.

eastern-forests.text: Owls, and something else answering them that is not an owl.

eastern-forests.action: hang the food out of reach
eastern-forests.threat: Something gets into the pack in the night. A day's food is gone and the rest is torn open.

eastern-forests.action: wake before the bear reaches the camp

threat.text: A bear comes into the camp after the food and does not leave when shouted at.

wilds.text: Lights on the horizon that are not a town, moving slowly, then gone.

wilds.action: keep the fire small and hidden
wilds.threat: Eyes at the edge of the firelight all night. Nobody sleeps.

threat.text: The wolves come in low from three sides at once.

any.text: A ruin from before the Reform: fallen walls, a stair going up to nothing, and cellars that go further down than they should.
A shrine to a god nobody names any more: a cut stone, old offerings, and new ones that someone left not long ago.
A cave mouth behind brush, cold air breathing out of it, with old soot on the roof from fires long out.
A lair: bones cracked for marrow, a smell that sticks to clothes, and tracks too big for wolves.
An old battlefield gone to grass, the barrows in rows and the odd rusted blade turned up by the plough nobody uses here.
A camp of people who would rather not be found: smoke, lean dogs, and watchers who saw the character first.
A hamlet that is on no map: a handful of houses, a well, and people who stop talking when a stranger walks in.

badlands.text: One of the old ward forts from the horde wars, the wards long failed, the gate down, and something living in the gatehouse.
A raiders' camp: hide tents, horses on a picket line, and trophies on poles.
Ground where the wards failed badly: the shale is warm, nothing grows, and the dead do not stay down.

wilds.text: Stonework older than anything in the Kingdoms, in a style nobody in Kingswood would recognise.
